# OpenCode Computer Use for Windows

A Windows computer-use plugin for OpenCode V1. Source version 0.2.0 incorporates [dsh-computer-use-win](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win) 0.6.3: Low disruption/Foreground/Hyper-V modes, iframe and canvas operations, bounded/delta observations, sensitive-operation approvals and the rebuilt settings controls. It retains signed session/turn context, cross-project desktop ownership and the single native settings command.

Requires Windows, Node.js 22+ and OpenCode V1 (tested with 1.18.0). OpenCode V2 is not supported by this entrypoint.

## Install and configure

Install globally from [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-computer-use-win):

~~~powershell
npm install --global opencode-computer-use-win --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
npm root --global
~~~

Alternatively, download and extract the tgz from a successful [GitHub Actions artifact](https://github.com/xshu-hub/opencode-computer-use-win/actions), then run:

~~~powershell
npm install --global --omit=dev --ignore-scripts .\opencode-computer-use-win-0.2.0.tgz
npm root --global
~~~

Add the same package name, `opencode-computer-use-win`, to the `plugin` array in both global `opencode.json(c)` and `tui.json` under `~/.config/opencode`. The host selects the server and TUI exports separately. The server entry may be `["opencode-computer-use-win", {"locale":"en"}]`. Preserve other entries, replace this plugin's old file entries and restart OpenCode. Pin the same `@version` in both files when required. npm provides published versions; build and use absolute entry-file URLs for an unpublished source version. Do not register a second manual wincu MCP server.

The TUI owns the only /computer-use slash command and opens settings without a model request. With OpenCode running, opencode-cu settings also opens the settings window. Other clients can use the computer_use_settings tool.

Sensitive launches, local-file navigation/uploads and personal-browser attachment/access require Allow once in the authenticated settings page. Decisions are bound to exact arguments, expire and cannot be replayed; cancellation refuses the waiting operation. OpenCode's own tool permissions still apply. Ordinary MCP reconnects retain the host-owned hidden desktop. Hyper-V requires a configured Windows VM with Node.js 22+; the settings page provides setup and a connection action.

Settings can check npm versions and download redacted diagnostics without uploading them. Updates use npm or the configured package version followed by restarting OpenCode. DSH marketplace installation and DSH restart are host-specific and are not invoked.

## Build and verify

~~~powershell
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
npm run test:ui
node test/run-opencode-host.mjs C:/path/to/opencode.exe
npm pack
~~~

CI builds and uploads an installable tarball. npm publication is a separate authenticated step. See [README.md](README.md), [installation details](docs/global-installation.md) and [validation](docs/validation-opencode-2026-11-13.md).

OpenCode V1 has no Desktop GUI settings-page plugin API, so settings open in a local browser window. Conversation tool/image rendering remains in OpenCode. A recording-exclusion regression reproduces in both the adapter and reference backend in the validation environment; the complete upstream suite is not claimed passing.

MIT. Preserve the upstream notices in LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY.md. The settings page omits the upstream promotion/feedback banner; attribution remains in repository documentation.

# OpenCode Computer Use for Windows

面向 OpenCode V1 的 Windows 电脑操控插件。提供 25 项操作工具和 1 项管理入口，支持桌面控件读取、截图、OCR、鼠标键盘输入、窗口管理，以及通过 CDP/BiDi 操作浏览器。

源码版本 0.2.0 已同步 [Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win) 0.6.3，包含少打扰/前台/Hyper-V 工作方式、iframe 与画布操作、观测输出压缩、敏感操作审批和新版设置控件，同时保留 OpenCode 会话/轮次绑定、跨项目桌面占用控制、取消与恢复及单一设置入口。来源和许可说明见 [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md)；设置页面不展示项目推广栏。

## 环境

- Windows，正常且已解锁的交互桌面。
- Node.js 22 或更新版本。
- OpenCode V1；实际验证版本为 1.18.0。当前不支持 OpenCode V2 的插件接口。
- 浏览器通道需要本机安装 Edge、Chrome 或受支持的 Firefox 系浏览器。

## 安装

通过 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-computer-use-win) 安装已发布版本，在 PowerShell 执行。源码的新版本需发布后才能按包名获取，也可以按下文自行构建 tgz：

~~~powershell
npm install --global opencode-computer-use-win --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
npm root --global
~~~

也可从 [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/xshu-hub/opencode-computer-use-win/actions) 成功构建的 opencode-computer-use-win artifact 下载并解压 tgz，离线包安装命令为：

~~~powershell
npm install --global --omit=dev --ignore-scripts .\opencode-computer-use-win-0.2.0.tgz
npm root --global
~~~

也可以从源码构建：

~~~powershell
git clone https://github.com/xshu-hub/opencode-computer-use-win.git
cd opencode-computer-use-win
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm pack
~~~

npm 与 tgz 安装使用相同的全局配置方式，见下文。

## 全局配置

npm 包通过包名关联，不需要填写本机安装路径。OpenCode 会按配置安装或缓存对应包；npm 全局安装主要提供 opencode-cu 命令。

在用户目录下的 .config/opencode/opencode.json 或 opencode.jsonc 中合并：

~~~json
{
  "plugin": [
    [
      "opencode-computer-use-win",
      { "locale": "zh" }
    ]
  ]
}
~~~

在同目录的 tui.json 中合并：

~~~json
{
  "plugin": [
    "opencode-computer-use-win"
  ]
}
~~~

保留现有配置和其他插件，只追加对应条目。重启 OpenCode 后，其他项目会继承全局配置。已有手动 mcp.wincu 条目时，先备份并移除该条目；wincu 由本插件管理。

需要固定版本时，两处包名都写成 opencode-computer-use-win@版本号。使用未发布的本地 tgz 或源码时，分别改为已安装目录下 opencode/plugin.mjs 与 opencode/tui.mjs 的绝对 file URI。替换旧条目，不要同时保留包名和本地文件两份注册。

更详细的路径获取和升级说明见 [全局安装说明](docs/global-installation.md)。

## 设置入口

- 在 TUI 输入 /computer-use，或从命令面板选择“电脑操控设置 / Computer Use settings”。
- OpenCode 已运行时，在系统终端执行 opencode-cu settings。
- 其他客户端可让 agent 调用 computer_use_settings。

/computer-use 只由 TUI 注册一次，直接打开设置，不调用模型。没有额外的服务端同名斜杠命令，也不需要修改 OpenCode 本体。

设置页保留全部/精简/懒启动/自定义工具方案、逐项开关、浏览器类型与可见性、保留登录、连接现有浏览器、接管提示、鼠标标签、浮窗原文/AI 总结、位置/尺寸/透明度/锁定、快捷键录制和实际预览。支持中英文切换。

工作方式默认“少打扰”；“前台操作”适用于你暂时不使用电脑时；Hyper-V 需要本机组件、权限、运行中的 Windows 虚拟机以及来宾 Node.js 22+，设置页提供配置引导和连接按钮。少打扰与前台切换实时生效，切换虚拟机或工具/浏览器方案会在当前调用结束后重连；普通 MCP 重连保留后台桌面。

带参数或快捷方式的程序启动、本地文件打开/上传、连接个人浏览器及首次访问已有标签页，需要在自动打开的设置窗口中“允许这一次”。拒绝、取消、超时或参数变化均不会执行原操作；授权与调用参数绑定且只能使用一次。OpenCode 自身的工具权限仍然生效。

设置页提供 npm 版本检查和脱敏诊断下载。更新通过 npm 或修改 OpenCode 中固定的包版本完成，再重启 OpenCode；上游依赖 DSH 插件市场的一键安装/重启没有直接移植。诊断不会自动上传，也不包含截图或完整对话。

数据保存在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\opencode-computer-use-win；可通过 OPENCODE_CU_HOME 指定其他目录。浏览器登录配置与原 DSH 插件隔离。显示设置实时生效；工具或浏览器配置在当前调用结束后重载。并发保存通过版本号检测冲突。

## 执行与停止

工具调用绑定 OpenCode 的真实会话 ID 和执行中的用户轮次，并携带宿主签名。队列中的用户提示、模型重试和系统生成的继续消息不会解除本轮停止。

真实鼠标键盘操作期间可按 Esc 或自定义快捷键停止，本轮后续操作将被拒绝。新用户任务或明确发送“继续”后恢复。浏览器后台操作不监听全局 Esc；使用 OpenCode 的停止按钮取消。原生输入清理结束前保持桌面占用，避免其他项目或会话插入操作。

截图通过标准 MCP 图片块交给 OpenCode，能否参与判断取决于模型及提供方的视觉能力。动作返回 sent 仅说明已发送，应使用新观察或 wait_for 确认效果。

AI 进度总结是可选的额外模型调用，使用当前任务的模型。仅传入受长度限制的操作标签和已公开的助手输出，不传截图、工具参数或完整对话；默认显示原文。

~~~powershell
npm test
npm run build
npm run test:ui
node test/run-opencode-host.mjs C:/path/to/opencode.exe
node test/screenshot-output.mjs
~~~

宿主测试使用真实 OpenCode 进程与隔离的本地模拟模型，验证管理 MCP、会话签名、动态工具刷新、会话互斥、取消/恢复、图片传递和 AI 总结，不使用个人模型密钥。UI 测试只操作隔离的无头 Edge 测试页面。

## 已知边界

OpenCode 1.18 没有原生 Desktop GUI 设置页扩展接口，设置通过本地浏览器窗口展示。对话里的工具详情与图片使用 OpenCode 自身的界面，不注入 DSH 专属聊天行分组。

管理员窗口、UAC、应用自身的自动化限制与参考后端相同。录屏隐藏选项的原生回归在验证环境中未通过，原项目也复现相同问题，当前不宣称已经修复。完整 upstream 测试集未被宣称全部通过。

# OpenCode adapter internals

The OpenCode 1.x entrypoint is `plugin.mjs`. It registers `wincu` as a managed stdio MCP server. Do not also configure a manual server with this name.

Version 0.2.0 incorporates upstream 0.6.3. Both global configuration files may use the same npm package name; explicit `./server` and `./tui` exports select separate modules. Local entry-file URLs remain supported.

- `approval.mjs` holds pending sensitive-operation decisions. The authenticated settings page can allow one exact call or decline it. The host then mints the upstream one-use HMAC grant; model-supplied private fields, changed arguments/settings, cancellation and expired/replayed decisions are refused. OpenCode's ordinary tool permissions remain in force.
- The host owns a lazily created background desktop across managed MCP reconnects. The Hyper-V relay verifies OpenCode signatures before forwarding and mirrors a local relay PID for cleanup tracking; guest PIDs must not be interpreted as host PIDs.
- Settings reuse the generated upstream client, with authenticated Hyper-V setup, npm version checks and redacted diagnostic downloads. DSH marketplace/restart and promotion controls are not rendered. Diagnostics omit DSH logs and do not upload reports.

- `../mcp/request-context.mjs`: authenticates the host-added session/turn/call context. Model-visible tool schemas are unchanged. Managed workers fail closed when context is missing, expired, altered or does not match the active desktop series.
- `activity.mjs`: maps OpenCode assistant messages, tool events and session termination to the reference takeover/progress file protocol. `chat.params` selects the executing user turn; queued prompts and synthetic continuation messages do not grant a new stop scope.
- `desktop-lock.mjs`: OS-owned named-pipe lease across OpenCode projects and processes. It is kept through model thinking and input cleanup, and released at turn end or after the reference 30-second idle interval. A process crash releases the OS resource.
- `store.mjs`: user settings, validation, atomic replacement, optimistic revision checking and serialization of concurrent saves.
- `settings-server.mjs`: an ephemeral loopback settings endpoint; bearer authentication, same-origin checks, strict Host checks and bounded JSON bodies. The browser receives its token in the URL fragment and removes it from the address bar.
- `build.mjs` / `settings-ui.js`: bundle the reference React settings component with a small OpenCode settings transport. The reference controls, validation, tool groups, shortcut recorder and previews are reused.
- `tui.mjs`: the sole owner of the native `/computer-use` command-palette / slash entry. It opens settings directly without a model turn. The server supplies `computer_use_settings` for clients without the TUI extension; it does not register a second slash command.

All Windows UIA, native input, OCR, capture, browser CDP/BiDi and indicator code remains in the reference locations. Only `mcp/server.mjs` adds a private host-context verification step; standalone MCP behavior remains available without `WCU_OPENCODE_TOKEN`. Overlay strings support `WCU_HOST_BRAND`, and the native cursor badge reads that brand.

## Settings application

Presentation settings update through the control file. Browser/tool selection changes wait for in-flight calls, then reconnect through OpenCode's public `client.mcp.add` API. Tool management waits for OpenCode's catalog-change event before the next model request. Settings saved in another plugin window are noticed by all instances. Overlay moves/resizes/lock/close are merged back only when their base values are still current.

The optional AI summary uses the current session's provider/model in a temporary, hidden-agent child session with all tools denied. Only bounded action labels and already-public assistant output are supplied. The temporary session is aborted and deleted after each request. It never receives screenshots, tool arguments, user prompts or another conversation's text.

## Host boundary

OpenCode 1.18.0 has server hooks and TUI extensions but no Desktop GUI settings-page API. Its settings extension therefore opens a local browser window with the full reference controls. Native MCP result/image rendering stays in OpenCode. DSH-specific chat-row grouping is not injected into OpenCode's GUI. OpenCode V2 has a different plugin API and is not claimed compatible with this V1 entrypoint.

## 0.2.2 — 2026-09-26

- **修复 `ocr` 的 `query` 参数被 schema 禁止**([#6](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/6)):handler 一直支持并处理 `query`(返回 `query`/`matched`),README 也已宣传,但 `additionalProperties: false` 的 schema 未声明该参数,规范客户端永远无法发送。现已加入 `ocr` 的 inputSchema。感谢 [@TomJerry234](https://github.com/TomJerry234) 的自动化审计。
- **统一 `viewMode`/`includeOffscreen` 的行为与文档**([#4](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/4)):这两个参数作用于 scope 解析与树遍历;`uia:rt:*` 形式的元素 id 由 RuntimeId 直接定位、按设计绕过视图过滤。现在所有路径都会校验 `viewMode` 合法性(此前非法值在 `uia:rt:*` 路径被静默吞掉、在 legacy 路径报错,行为不一致),schema 描述与 `docs/wiki/mcp-tools.md` 已写明该语义。
- **`activate` 参数在所有声明它的路径上生效或如实文档化**([#5](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/5)):此前 `activate` 只在 drag/type_text/keypress 与元素解析路径被读取。现在 `click`/`double_click`/`move`/`scroll` 的 x/y 坐标路径也会先激活目标窗口(坐标输入命中的是物理位置的像素,目标被遮挡时输入会静默落到遮挡窗口上);`ocr` 在 `activate: true` 时先置前再截屏(被遮挡窗口截到的是遮挡者像素;激活被前台锁拒绝时在结果里加 `warning` 而不失败);`move_window` 尊重 `activate: true`(去掉硬编码的 `SWP_NOACTIVATE`,并通过 `Set-WindowForeground` 助手强制置前——`SetWindowPos` 的隐式激活会被 Windows 前台锁静默拒绝;结果新增 `activated` 字段,被拒时附 `warning`),默认仍不抢焦点;`element_info` 的 FromPoint 路径同样先激活。`close_window`(WM_CLOSE 后台即可)与 `activate_window`(工具本身就是激活)按文档写明语义。感谢 [@TomJerry234](https://github.com/TomJerry234) 的自动化审计。
- 修复 `mcp/server.mjs` 硬编码 `SERVER_VERSION` 与 `package.json` 版本漂移的问题:现在从 `package.json` 读取版本号。
- **Fixed the `ocr` `query` parameter being forbidden by its own schema** ([#6](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/6)): the handler always supported and processed `query` (returning `query`/`matched`) and the README advertised it, but the `additionalProperties: false` inputSchema never declared it, so schema-respecting clients could not send it. `query` is now part of the `ocr` schema. Thanks to [@TomJerry234](https://github.com/TomJerry234) for the automated schema-vs-implementation audit.
- **Made `viewMode`/`includeOffscreen` behaviour consistent and documented** ([#4](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/4)): the two parameters apply to scope resolution and tree walking; `uia:rt:*` element ids are looked up directly by RuntimeId and bypass view filtering by design. `viewMode` is now validated on every path (an illegal value used to be silently swallowed on the `uia:rt:*` path while the legacy path threw), and the schema descriptions plus `docs/wiki/mcp-tools.md` document the semantics.
- **`activate` now works or is honestly documented on every path that declares it** ([#5](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/5)): `activate` was only read by drag/type_text/keypress and element-target resolution. Now the x/y coordinate paths of `click`/`double_click`/`move`/`scroll` activate the target window first (coordinate input hits whatever is physically under the point — with the target occluded, input silently landed on the overlapping window); `ocr` brings the window forward before capturing when `activate: true` (an occluded window captured the occluder's pixels; if the foreground lock refuses activation the result carries a `warning` instead of failing); `move_window` honours `activate: true` (the hardcoded `SWP_NOACTIVATE` is now conditional, and the switch is enforced via the `Set-WindowForeground` helper — `SetWindowPos`'s implicit activation is silently refused by the Windows foreground lock; the result gains an `activated` field plus a `warning` when refused, default unchanged); `element_info`'s FromPoint path activates too. `close_window` (WM_CLOSE works in the background) and `activate_window` (the tool is the activation) now document their semantics. Thanks to [@TomJerry234](https://github.com/TomJerry234) for the automated audit.
- Fixed `mcp/server.mjs` reporting a hardcoded `SERVER_VERSION` that drifted from `package.json`: the version is now read from `package.json`.

## 0.2.1 — 2026-09-26

- 修复窗口激活无条件调用 `SW_RESTORE` 的问题：对最大化/贴靠窗口执行带 `activate: true` 的工具时会取消其最大化并重置位置大小（含用户自己的宿主窗口，并连带导致坐标点击偏移）。现在仅当窗口确实最小化（`IsIconic`）时才还原，其余情况不动窗口状态。感谢 [@snmtg1008](https://github.com/snmtg1008) 在 [#2](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/2) 中定位并给出修法。
- Fixed window activation unconditionally calling `SW_RESTORE`: any tool run with `activate: true` un-maximized maximized/snapped windows and reset their position and size (including the user's own host window, and cascading into misaligned coordinate clicks). `SW_RESTORE` is now issued only when the window is actually minimized (`IsIconic`); otherwise the window state is left untouched. Thanks to [@snmtg1008](https://github.com/snmtg1008) for diagnosing the issue and proposing the fix in [#2](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win/issues/2).
